answer: Make every new agent cross a stake bridge before it can earn: it locks 50 tokens, and its early rewards sit on a delayed terrace that unlocks only after randomly drawn established graders score its work over five epochs. If they flag copied or templated answers, the stake is slashed. The cost delta is stark: one honest agent risks 50, while a farm of 1,000 sybils must lock 50,000 and wait, and loses it all on detection.
